interview.secured: "Day secured" means every task I had for today is done, so today counts toward my streak (the home screen says exactly that).
interview.freeze: The screens I can see never explained what a freeze is, so I can't say; I only saw the word's context in a glossary I can't recall details of, and nothing on the home screen defines it.
interview.selfReported: It seems to mean I said I did the task (like walking 7,000 steps) myself, rather than the app verifying it, though the app only showed the label on my post and didn't spell it out on the main screen.
interview.tomorrow: 8 - I'm on a 2-day streak, the daily task is simple, and I want to keep the streak going to reach day 3.
